item.tib: gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las g.yung drung tshe lung gsang ba'i yang snying
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas a dkar theg pa chen po'i grol phug gsas mkhar spyi dril gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrab pa las/ g.yung drung tshe lung gsang ba'i yang snying 'di yang / 'chi med yum sras gsum gyi lung don/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ dbal gshen stag la nyid kyi mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i brnags pa/ stang chen dmu tsha nyid kyi smar byang / mkhas pa de yis byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la grub pa bsnyems nas shin tu zab par mdzad ste (de/)bka' ni gsang ba'i brag la bka' rtags mtshal gyis (gyi)brda' yig gis rgyas gdab (gtab) nas sbas/ man ngag ni stang chen gyi thugs la gab po (bo/)phyis su rten 'brel legs pa'i dbu bsnyes nas/ skabs su bab pa'i kho bo bdag la dngos grub gnang ba'i gsas mkhar gsang ba'i dril sgrab 'di yang / dpal snya chen mchog gi gar rol 7khyung dkar grub pa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi gser khrir skyong ba 7spyang 'phags rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags mchog gi lha rdzas dar dkar gyis sna drangs te bka' gsungs (gsung) spyi bor phab pa dang*/ ma zad mkhas pa'i nor la dbang ba'i 7drang srong nam mkha' tshul khrims bstan 'dzin dbang grags kyis rin chen dang po'i glegs bam dang dar dkar lha rdzas gyis mtshams sbyar/ dpal ldan nor gling gi 'tshogs chen zhal ngo btsun pa bsam gtan rgyal mtshan dang rigs mthun grogs po stag rgod drang srong dbang 'dus dang*/ brtse gdung gcig tu 'dres pa'i bka' slob btsun pa tshul khrims blo gros sogs don gnyer can 'ga' yis/ rten 'brel dar dkar chun po dang rin chen gnyis pa'i 'khor los sna drangs te bskul pa la brten te/ stang chen dmu tsha nyid kyi bka' yi pho nya/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'jug rgod rje rgya yi gdung las dal rten rnyed pa'i u0f38tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am 7gsang ba'i ming ni?g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa'i rgyal khams kyi khol po pa des/ dbal gshen phur pa nag pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas kyi mdun zhol/ bstan pa'i me ro spor ba'i rlung g.yab bon gyi 'dus sde chen po dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du lo dus kyi gsang rgya yol nas stong (stang) chen dmu tsha'i zhal lung bzhin du yi ger gtan la phab pa'o/ 'di bris nyes ltung 'gal ba ci mchis rnams/ gsang sngags gsang ba'i lha la mthol lo bshags/ legs nyes stangs 'dzin bka' yi bya ra mas/ bka' chad thugs ngan rko long zhi gyur cig dge tshogs ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ kun kyang bla med 'bras bu thob par shog/
